profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Android Tech Lead: built features for the TikTok Android app: creator tools (editing & publishing), playlists, discover page, video comments, question-and-answer, page optimizations, push notifications, accessibility.
- Led high-priority projects, aligned stakeholders across U.S. and China, mentored junior developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco Bay Area / New York City
positions.description:
[Android]
- Built the Uber Eats food delivery app and Uber Freight trucking app on Android (was one of the original founding engineers for both apps); shipped full features and was responsible for app architecture, stability, scalability, user growth, testing, experimentation, analytics, and product iterations.
- Built the self-driving trip experience by developing for in-vehicle tablets and the Uber rider app. 
- Tech led growth features and mentored junior developers.

[Full-Stack]
- Developed features for the Uber for Business platform: chat system for coordinators to communicate with drivers on Uber Health, mobile development strategy for vouchers platform, mobile-web dashboard UI for requesting rides, monitoring, alerting, analytics. (Golang, Kafka, DynamoDB, React)

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed features for Trulia’s suite of Android apps for homebuyers and real estate agents, such as a task list feature for agents and Chromecast integration for viewing image galleries of home listings.
- Wrote automated Android UI tests using Espresso and Appium.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on StubHub's data platform to enhance a mapreduce job service using Java, Spring, Jersey, Tomcat, Maven, Quartz. 
- Helped develop framework and command-line interface for configuring, executing and managing mapreduce jobs.

positions.title: Lead Information Security Engineer
positions.description:
- Handled security operations and policy for ~10,000 individuals and 14,000 machines on campus.
- Led a team of 5 to complete a variety of security projects (e.g. web app audits, pentesting).

Former Positions: 
Computing Consultant; Network Engineering Assistant 
May 2012 – May 2013 | Berkeley, CA
- Resolved hardware and software issues (e.g. reformats, encryption, system configuration, router setup).
- Staffed the help desk phone line to provide courteous and prompt customer service for residents.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed data visualizations on user profile pages that displayed algorithmic-driven recommendations of other users to connect with
- Used d3 JavaScript libraries, HTML/CSS, Ruby on Rails, SQL in development process
- Ideated, storyboarded, and created mockups of interactive games for users to play on the site

positions.title: Global Wealth Manager
positions.description:
- Referred $200,000-$3 million in investable assets to top producing financial advisory teams.
- Analyzed financial models and asset allocation strategies to increase client flow and secure accounts.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
•	Managed internal store operations and increased annual sales revenue by 71% (2011-2012).
•	Directed team of 9 executive board members, 8 sales and marketing associates, 7 designers.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Performed domestic and international market research, industry overviews, competitive analysis.
- Constructed comprehensive, 239-page client project deliverable with revenue projections and implementation plan.
- Managed and coached five consultants on survey design, research tactics, data analysis, report writing.

company.name: International Association of Business Communicators (Consulting Division)

courses.name: Analytic Decision Modeling and Linear Programming

honors.title: Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: The Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing is the World's Largest Gathering of Women Technologists. It is produced by the Anita Borg Institute and presented in partnership with ACM. GHC Scholarship Grants enable students and faculty to attend the Grace Hopper Celebration (GHC) and connect with other women in computing.
honors.issuer: Issued by Anita Borg Institute · Jul 2014

honors.title: Ambassador for the Haas Undergraduate Leadership Award (HULA)
honors.description: The HAN-SF Undergraduate Leadership Award (HULA) is a competitive merit-based scholarship program that recognizes Haas undergraduate students who demonstrate potential or applied leadership within their studies, extracurricular activities, communities, or families.
honors.issuer: Issued by Haas Alumni Network - SF Chapter · Dec 2012

volunteerExperiences.description:
CodePath provides college students with no-cost coding courses, mentorship, and career support to prepare them for careers in tech.

I'm an instructor for CodePath's summer technical interview prep program of ~700 students, most of whom are first generation college students from low-income households. I also teach the Android Mobile App Development course for college students.

Code the Change at Berkeley is an organization that helps computer scientists use their skills for social change. We work with nonprofits on impactful web development projects.

- Formed Code the Change at Berkeley to help computer scientists use their skills for social change.
- Established partnerships with over 20 nonprofit clients to coordinate web/mobile app development projects.
- Developed mobile web app for GreatNonprofits.org.

projects.title: Homeschool
projects.description: MEAN-stack MOOC platform for homebuying education, real estate investing, and agent training.

organizations.name: CodePath
organizations.description:
http://codepath.com

CodePath provides free, accelerated mobile engineering classes for professional developers and designers in San Francisco.

Each week participants complete functional mobile applications and receive code reviews in addition to attending a weekly lecture, lab, and working on a group project. This bootcamp covers all the major topics required to architect and implement polished Android applications.
